GET /accounts/{account_id}/reporting/pol.description: Lists all reporting policies for an account.

schema.description: Cloudflare public account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

enabled.description: Whether the policy is currently active and will generate reports according to schedule

policy_description.description: Optional detailed description of what the policy does and when it runs
policy_description.example: Generates a comprehensive security report every Monday covering firewall events and threat analysis

policy_id.description: Unique identifier for the policy (UUID format)

policy_name.description: Human-readable name for the policy (required, non-empty)

policy_schedule.description: Cron expression for scheduling (format: minute hour day month weekday). Example: '0 9 * * 1' runs every Monday at 9:00 AM

valid_from.description: Start date when this policy version becomes effective

valid_to.description: End date when this policy version expires (omitted for active policies)

version.description: Version number of the policy (incremented when policy is modified, starts at 1)
